items.title: イギリス 16歳未満のSNS利用を禁止する方針

items.title: 大谷翔平が最多得票 大リーグオールスターファン投票中間結果

items.title: トランプ大統領 “覚書すでに署名 19日にホルムズ海峡開放”

items.title: 天皇陛下 公式訪問先のオランダで17世紀建造の宮殿を視察

items.title: Trump says deal to end war with Iran already signed and details to be released 'pretty soon'

items.summary: US President Donald Trump has said a preliminary deal to end the war with Iran has already been signed and suggested that details of the agreement are set to be published "pretty soon".

items.title: 日銀 きょう金融政策決定会合2日目の議論 利上げ判断へ
items.title_zh: JCIA金融政策决定会议第2天
items.summary: 日銀は16日、2日目の金融政策決定会合を開き、去年12月以来となる利上げを決める見通しです。イラン情勢の影響による原油高や円安傾向を受けて物価上昇への対応を急ぐ必要があるとして、政策金利を31年ぶりの…
items.summary_zh: 尼信将在16日和2日召开金融政策决策会,决心自去年12月起增加兴趣. 政策利率是31年来第一次,因为由于受伊朗局势的影响,原油高涨和日元走势导致物价上涨。

items.title: Delhi's temperature showed 43.5C. Why did it feel hotter?
items.title_zh: 德里的温度显示为43.5C. 为什么感觉更热?
items.summary: For several weeks now, the Indian capital, Delhi, has been battling a severe heatwave, with temperatures routinely rising above 40C. The real feel, the weather apps helpfully tell us, is always a few degrees higher. But how hot do you feel when you hit the streets?
items.summary_zh: 印度首都德里数周来一直在对抗一场严重的热浪,气温通常会上升至40C以上。 真正的感觉,天气应用 帮助告诉我们, 总是几度高。 但是,你感觉多热 当你上街?

items.summary_zh: 最后,在似乎无数虚假的开始之后,美国和伊朗达成了协议。 双方都可以预测地声称取得了胜利。

items.title: Is the convertible heading into the sunset?
items.title_zh: 敞篷车朝夕阳走去吗?
items.summary: Sophistication, freedom, rebellion or just the simple joy of taking to the open road with the wind in your hair. The convertible car used to represent all of these. But over the past two decades sales have collapsed, and its future seems deeply uncertain. So what's gone wrong?
items.summary_zh: 高谈阔论,自由论,平叛论,或只是带着头发被风吹走去开阔道路的简单快活. 敞篷车曾经代表所有这些. 但在过去二十年中,销售额已经倒闭,其未来似乎十分不确定. 出什么问题了?

items.summary: The New York Knicks won the NBA championship on Saturday night, clinching the fifth game in the best-of-seven series against the San Antonio Spurs. The Knicks secured the title, 94-90, while playing in Texas.
items.summary_zh: 纽约尼克斯队于周六晚上获得NBA联赛冠军,在最佳七连胜圣安东尼奥斯普尔斯的比赛中打入了第五局. 尼克斯队在德克萨斯州打球时获得了94-90的头衔.

items.title: Why the US economy keeps defying the odds
items.title_zh: 为何美国经济总是不惜一切代价
items.summary: In Dresden, in east Germany late last year, the final car rolled off the assembly line at Volkswagen's "Transparent Factory", built to showcase the pinnacle of European industrial power. Thousands of miles away in Spartanburg, South Carolina, a different German giant, BMW, is running its biggest plant in the world.
items.summary_zh: 去年晚些时候,在德累斯顿,最后一辆汽车在大众汽车的"透明工厂"上从装配线上滚出,建造这辆汽车是为了展示欧洲工业实力的顶峰. 在南卡罗来纳州斯巴丹堡的数千英里外,一个不同的德国巨头宝马正在经营其世界上最大的植物.

items.title: Vincent's parents 'never say he's good enough' - so he turned to a middle-aged couple online

items.summary: During mealtimes, Vincent Zhang, a tech worker in Shanghai, has a habit of whipping out his phone to check on his "virtual parents": a middle-aged couple online, armed with an endless stream of warm words for their imaginary child.
items.summary_zh: 吃饭期间,上海科技工作者文森特·张有鞭打出手机检查"虚拟父母"的习惯:一对中年夫妇在线上,用无尽一流的温暖的词来表达他们想象中的孩子.
